meta.source: myDecs decoration certificates (AF Form 2228B family) as myDecs prints them
meta.notes: Measured off three certificates myDecs itself produced (an Air and Space Achievement Medal, an Air and Space Commendation Medal with oak leaf cluster, and a Meritorious Service Medal with oak leaf cluster), read with pdftotext -bbox-layout. All three agree: letter page, the citation set in Courier 11 point, fully justified, between one-inch margins (468 pt, 165.1 mm), 70 characters on the fullest line, line pitch 13.38 pt, and exactly 20 lines between ACCOMPLISHMENTS and GIVEN UNDER MY HAND -- every one of the three ran to the twentieth line and no further. Their citations were 1291, 1340 and 1347 characters, which is what a 1350-character cap looks like when it is real. The header layout below (line texts, sizes and vertical positions in points from the top of the page) is transcribed from the same three certificates; the Achievement and Commendation Medals share the Department of the Air Force header, the Meritorious Service Medal carries the Presidential header with its Executive Order line. The certificates are not committed: they name real people. Liberation Mono is metrically identical to Courier and redistributable under the SIL Open Font License.
